quote: A signal of intention to turn left or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

activation.condition: A motor-vehicle driver intends to turn from a direct course on a highway.

obligation.description: Give a continuous turn signal over the applicable last traveled distance before changing course.

timing.description: Continuous during the applicable last traveled feet prior to changing course, regardless of weather.
